DECLARE @hasParentTran BIT
DECLARE @caseId INT
DECLARE @apptId INT
DECLARE @currProfileConfigId INT = 16
DECLARE @sendEmailAlert BIT = 1
DECLARE @emailParamList VARCHAR(MAX)
DECLARE @emailAlertId INT
DECLARE @emailId INT
DECLARE @providerId INT

DECLARE @Inserted TABLE (id INT)

--find all appts that is about to happen (in 1 day) and send email alert to member to remind them about their appointment
DECLARE CursorAppt CURSOR FOR
SELECT A.apptId
FROM [Case].vwAppt A
WHERE A.apptStatusConfigId IN (196,197) --196=scheduled,197=confirmed
	AND CONVERT(DATE, A.apptStart) > CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) --apptdate is in the future
	AND DATEDIFF(DAY, CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()), CONVERT(DATE, A.apptStart)) = 1 --apptdate is about to happen in 1 day
	AND A.reminderEmailSentOn IS NULL --email has not been sent yet
	--AND A.apptId = 3265 --for testing only

OPEN CursorAppt
FETCH NEXT FROM CursorAppt INTO @apptId

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN

	BEGIN TRY

		--if no outer tran started, start tran 
		IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0
		BEGIN 
			SET @hasParentTran = 0; 
			BEGIN TRAN; 
		END
		ELSE 
		BEGIN 
			SET @hasParentTran = 1; 
		END

		SELECT
			@caseId = A.caseId,
			@providerId = A.providerId
		FROM [Case].Appt A
		INNER JOIN [Case].MemberCase C ON C.caseId = A.caseId
		WHERE A.apptId = @apptId

		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Email.EmailAlert WHERE emailAlertId = 20 AND isActive = 1) --20=appt email reminder
		AND ISNULL(@sendEmailAlert,0) = 1
		BEGIN
			SET @sendEmailAlert = 1	
			SET @emailAlertId = 20
		END
		ELSE 
			SET @sendEmailAlert = 0

		--if alert is needed, then create email record to queue
		IF @sendEmailAlert = 1
		BEGIN
			DELETE @Inserted --empty out temptable

			SET @emailParamList = 
				'apptId=' + LTRIM(@apptId) +
				'|providerId=' + ISNULL(LTRIM(@providerId),'') +
				'|caseId=' + LTRIM(@caseId)
			INSERT INTO Email.Email(profileConfigId, emailStatusConfigId, emailAlertId, emailParamList) 
			OUTPUT INSERTED.emailId INTO @Inserted 
			VALUES (@currProfileConfigId, 513, @emailAlertId, @emailParamList) --513=queued 

			SET @emailId = (SELECT TOP 1 id FROM @Inserted)

			UPDATE A SET 
				reminderEmailId = @emailId
			FROM [Case].Appt A
			WHERE A.apptId = @apptId
		END



		--no problem found, if no outer tran, commit
		IF (@@TRANCOUNT > 0 AND @hasParentTran = 0)
		BEGIN 
			COMMIT; 
		END;	
		
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		--problem occurred; if no outer tran, rollback this tran (and its child trans)
		IF (@@TRANCOUNT > 0)
		BEGIN 
		--rollback above transactions then create log
			ROLLBACK; 
			--create an error log
			INSERT App.[Log](logTypeConfigId, logDateTime, userId, logNotes, sqlProcedure, sqlErrorNumber, sqlerrorMessage)
			SELECT 
				434, --sqlexception
				GETDATE(),
				1,
				logNotes = 
				'apptId=' + LTRIM(@apptId),
				'Send Reminder Email SSIS Script',
				SUBSTRING(LTRIM(ERROR_NUMBER()), 1, 50),
				SUBSTRING(LTRIM(ERROR_MESSAGE()), 1, 8000)
		END; 
		--THROW; --dont bubble up; comment this out because loop should continute even when 1 recordline has error

	END CATCH;

	FETCH NEXT FROM CursorAppt INTO @apptId	
END
CLOSE CursorAppt
DEALLOCATE CursorAppt
